pressure.pumpRule: human: key-down of key0 or key1 counts only if different from the previous key (alternate 0/1); +1 per valid press, resets leak counter
pressure.leak: leak counter +1/tick; when >5 → reset and pressure-1 (if >0)
pressure.ai: 25% per tick: +1 and reset leak counter

sprite.frame: (pressure/36)*3 + wobble[phase]; wobble = [0,1,0,2], phase cycles 0→1→2→3→0 every tick (tables 0x4432d4/0x4432e4)

layout.gauge: 04/player{slot+1}: frame1 at (x, H - h/2 - OY), fill bar width pressure/2 (0..90) from x-66, rows y-11..y+12 colour RGB(255,244,53), frame0 overlay on top

win: first slot with pressure >= 180 → FINISH → board mode: word-card result; standalone: return
timeout: 30 s → TIME IS UP, no reward
